summary: In the exact-rank-three near-coloop Parseval frame, for any two-bank partition with positive transverse Grams G_J+G_K=I, least-squares longitudinal slopes q_B and innovations delta_B satisfy the exact identity 1-h=delta_J^2+delta_K^2+(q_J-q_K)^T G_J G_K(q_J-q_K). Under I/4<=G_B<=3I/4, all two one-bank innovations and the inter-bank slope separation therefore vanish together as h->1. Hence the proposed implication 'both one-bank innovations small forces an order-one inter-bank slope separation' is false. An exact target witness has h=1, G_J=G_K=I/2, both innovations and slope separation zero, while Lambda=[[0,1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]] has spectrum {1,-1,1}. This is not a QFORM counterexample; account02/B16 r36 controls the witness by <7.56 via the fresh-hub zero-pivot receiver. The remaining punctured-collar mechanism must stay finite as h->1 and cannot invert these vanishing currencies.
